record.question: Which laboratory test is a common marker used to measure the level of inflammation in the body?
record.explanation: Answer C: C-reactive protein (CRP) test. CRP is an acute-phase protein that rises with inflammation and its blood test is commonly used as a nonspecific inflammation marker. CBC findings can also reflect inflammation, but CBC is not a single inflammation marker. Reference: https://medlineplus.gov/lab-tests/c-reactive-protein-crp-test/; https://medlineplus.gov/ency/article/003356.htm. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
